ks-city-ward-lines.summary: In three of Kansas's 16 cities of 25,000 people or more, Lenexa, Shawnee and Leawood, this app cannot show which ward the spot you picked is in, because it has no map of the city's current wards that it may draw.
ks-city-ward-lines.why: Lenexa's wards are published only on a county map server that asks automated readers to stay away, and the maps Shawnee and Leawood publish divide their people unevenly on the 2020 census, so they may be out of date.
ks-city-ward-lines.wanted: Lenexa's current ward map as a map layer or a file of its lines this project may read, and word from Shawnee and Leawood on whether the ward map each publishes is the one in force.

ks-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
ks-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Kansas's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
ks-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

ks-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app names the mayor and council or commission of Kansas's 16 cities of 25,000 people or more, and not those of its smaller cities.
ks-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Kansas's city officials has been read for this app. The 16 are read from each city's own pages, and the smaller cities' pages have not been read one by one.
ks-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of every city's mayor and council members, kept current, that says which seats each ward elects and which the whole city elects.

ks-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
ks-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Kansas's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ks-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

ks-township-officers.summary: Where a township has a government of its own, the Township or City card says so and does not name its officers.
ks-township-officers.why: No list of Kansas's township officers has been read for this app yet, statewide or county by county.
ks-township-officers.wanted: A statewide list of township officers, or each county's or township's own published list of them.

ks-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website. It names the Prairie Band Potawatomi Nation's council, and not yet the other three nations' councils.
ks-tribal-government.why: This app has not read the council lists of Kansas's other three nations yet. Each nation publishes its own, which has to be read one nation at a time.
ks-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council, read one nation at a time.
